title: Settings
sub: Configure how contracts are sent, signed and kept.

general.timezoneHint: Dates in emails and certificates use this zone.
general.prefixHint: 2–8 capital letters or digits, e.g. CTR.

branding.displayNameHint: Shown to signers and in emails. Defaults to the organisation name.
branding.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 600 KB. Shown on your signing pages.
branding.noLogo: No logo uploaded. The Bilit.event E-Sign logo is used.

signing.includeIp: Show IP addresses on the completion certificate

email.useOrgHint: When off, the platform's mail server is used.
email.passwordSet: A password is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
email.testSent: Test email accepted by the server and sent to {to}.
email.testHint: Sends a real message to your own address using the settings above (save first).
email.verified: Connected to {host}:{port}. No email was sent.
email.verifiedAuth: Connected and signed in to {host}:{port}. No email was sent.

sms.tokenSet: A token is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
sms.testSent: Test SMS accepted by the provider.
sms.hint: Without a provider, SMS is never sent and messages are recorded as “not sent”.

notifications.onView: Email me when a recipient views a document
notifications.onSign: Email me when a recipient signs
notifications.completedToSigners: Email the completed document notice to signers
notifications.attach: Attach the final PDF to the completion email

reminders.hint: Reminders stop as soon as a person signs or the contract ends.

retention.warn: Warn owners this many days before
retention.auto: Delete automatically when the period ends
retention.autoWarn: Automatic deletion removes document files permanently. Hashes and the audit trail are kept until the audit period ends. Nothing is deleted unless this is on.

security.elevation: Re-check identity for sensitive actions every (minutes)

templates.sub: Customise the emails signers and your team receive. Changes are versioned and previewed before saving.
templates.subject: Subject

privacy.note: Controls how long form-access analytics (IP address, browser, device, visit times) are kept. Answers, audit records and signed documents follow their own settings.
privacy.ipHint: 0 keeps full IPs. Otherwise the last part is removed once this many days have passed.
privacy.telemetryHint: 0 keeps them until you delete them.
